name: secure-saas-infra
description: Fail-closed AWS Organizations management-seed IaC and rootless bootstrap.

scripts.check: node scripts/verify-management-seed-scope.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.management-seed.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.management-seed-policy.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.management-seed-support.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.management-seed-test.json --noEmit
scripts.validate:g0: npm run format:check && node scripts/validate-management-seed-syntax.mjs && npm run launcher:vet && npm run launcher:test && npm run launcher:build && npm run check && npm run build && npm run policy:build && npm run support:build && npm run verify:build && npm run validate:contracts && npm run validate:management-seed-policies
scripts.validate:local: npm run validate:g0 && npm run validate:g1
scripts.validate:source: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run security:secrets && npm run security:go-vuln && npm run validate:local && npm run security:audit && npm run sbom -- --output artifacts/secure-saas-infra.spdx.json
scripts.validate: npm run validate:g0 && npm run validate:g1
scripts.test:iac: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-management-seed-test',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.management-seed-test.json && node -e "const f=require('node:fs');f.mkdirSync('dist-management-seed-test/scripts',{recursive:true});for(const n of ['management-seed-model.cjs','management-seed-policy-model.cjs'])f.copyFileSync('scripts/'+n,'dist-management-seed-test/scripts/'+n)" && node scripts/run-iac-unit-tests.mjs
scripts.test: npm run validate:g0 && npm run validate:g1
scripts.verify:all: npm run gates:local && npm run evidence:release -- --gate-report artifacts/local-gate-evidence.json --require-clean --output artifacts/security-contract-evidence.json
